## Personality

Martin is characterized by others as unreliable. He is tasked with looking after a large amount of stock, though he is considered insufficient for managing that level of responsibility.

_Sources: [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P29](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0029)_

## History

Martin was hired to work at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) a year prior to Matthew's death. During his time employed there, four of the estate's cows died under his watch.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXXVII. The Reaper Whose Name Is Death P2](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0002), [v1 CHAPTER XXXVII.
